newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * A group of 28 U.S. Senators sent a letter to Romanian President Emil Constantinescu pledging to lobby for Romania to win an invitation to start NATO membership talks in 1999.
* Two workers from the fertiliser maker Oltchim SA in Ramnicu Valcea died on Friday after gas leaked from a pipe. Police are invatigating the case.
